name: Méntrida
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO in northern Toledo province, bordering Ávila and Madrid, from the foot of the Sierra de Gredos down to the Tagus and a little beyond it. Its municipalities include Talavera de la Reina and Toledo. Garnacha is the main grape, and Tempranillo and Syrah are also allowed.
